wiki.title: Esmeralda Soria
wiki.extract: Esmeralda Zamudio Soria (born April 22, 1982) is an American politician and adjunct professor who is serving in the California State Assembly for the 27th district since 2022. Previously, she served as a member of the Fresno City Council from 2015 to 2022, with Soria serving as Council President from 2015 to 2022.
